cards.title: STOP skill
cards.summary: Create a pause between intense urge and action.
cards.when_to_use: High emotion or impulsive urge when a brief pause is possible.
steps: Proceed with the next effective action.

cards.title: Behavior chain analysis
cards.summary: Map prompting event, vulnerabilities, links, target behavior, and consequences.
cards.when_to_use: Repeated problem behavior or a confusing escalation.
steps: Trace thoughts, emotions, sensations, urges, and actions.
Identify links where skills or environmental changes could help.
cautions: For life-threatening behavior, pair analysis with professional safety planning.

cards.title: Check the facts
cards.summary: Compare emotion assumptions with observable facts.
cards.when_to_use: Emotion intensity may be based partly on interpretations or predictions.
steps: Check probability and severity of feared outcomes.
Choose problem solving, acceptance, or opposite action.
cautions: Validating facts does not mean minimizing discrimination, trauma, abuse, or danger.

cards.title: Opposite action
cards.summary: Act opposite an emotion-driven urge when the emotion or its intensity does not fit the facts.
cards.when_to_use: Emotion urges are ineffective and the situation is safe.
steps: Do it fully enough to gather new information.
cautions: Do not use opposite action to suppress valid protective responses to danger.

cards.title: DEAR MAN
cards.summary: Organize an assertive request or boundary.

cards.title: GIVE relationship skill
cards.summary: Support relationship effectiveness while preserving authenticity.
cards.when_to_use: When maintaining connection matters alongside the objective.
steps: Show interest in a way that is authentic/accessibly communicated.
Use an easy manner only if it is genuine and safe.
cautions: Do not require masking or appeasement as the price of safety.

cards.title: FAST self-respect skill
cards.when_to_use: When guilt, pressure, or fear is pushing someone to violate their values.
steps: Be fair to yourself and others.
Limit unnecessary apologies for existing or having needs.

cards.title: Radical acceptance
cards.summary: Acknowledge reality that cannot be changed right now so energy can move toward effective action.
cards.when_to_use: Pain is being amplified by fighting an already-existing fact.
steps: Name the fact that is already true.
Notice urges to argue with reality.
Choose the next effective action within current limits.
cautions: Never frame accepting abuse or danger as staying in it; acceptance can include leaving, reporting, or seeking help.
